# Sander Dekker

> Amsterdam-based documentary photographer working on identity, self-expression and social acceptance — through zines, exhibitions and limited editions.

## About

Sander Dekker (born 1975, the Netherlands) is a contemporary photographer based in Amsterdam. His work explores themes of identity, freedom, self-expression and social acceptance. He creates long-form documentary photography projects that are published as zines, shown in exhibitions, and sold as limited edition prints.

## Projects

- **The Social Media Project** — A documentary series exploring how people present themselves online versus in real life, photographed across New York, London and other cities.
- **The Social Landscape** — A documentary film and photography project about the contemporary social landscape.
- **The Zine Project** — A self-published zine series documenting people and moments.
- **Girls in Paris** — A photography project shot in Paris.
- **Warsaw Saga** — A documentary project set in Warsaw, Poland.
- **Innate Curiosity** — A project about natural human curiosity and exploration.

## Works & Editions

Limited edition fine art prints available at: https://www.mynameissanderdekker.com/works

## Exhibitions

Sander Dekker has exhibited at galleries and art fairs in Amsterdam, London, New York and other cities.
